reason: Conversation 2 directly answers the question with 'No, please don't', explains that reconnecting a gas hose is not a push-on job and needs a Gas Safe engineer, and gives a clear ordered emergency sequence: turn off at the meter, avoid sparks, ventilate, get everyone out (important with kids upstairs), and call 0800 111 999 from outside. It also covers follow-up with a Gas Safe engineer and the stability chain, and suggests no part purchase. Conversation 1 gives correct but terse emergency advice; it never answers the DIY reconnect question, does not tell him not to touch the hose, and does not say to get everyone out or to call from outside, so it is less likely to overcome his reluctance and protect the children.
